title: The Real Reason Your Brain Causes Déjà Vu
hook: Your brain sometimes plays a trick, making new moments feel old.

narration.text: Your brain sometimes plays a trick, making new moments feel old.
Déjà vu happens when your brain processes information a tiny bit out of sync.
One part of your brain registers a scene just milliseconds before another.
When the second part catches up, it feels like you have already experienced it.
It is not a memory from the past, just a processing glitch in the present.
This momentary delay makes the new input seem familiar and remembered.
So, that strange feeling is just your brain catching up with itself.
Have you ever experienced déjà vu in a really vivid way?

description: Ever wondered why déjà vu happens? It is not a forgotten memory or a psychic premonition. It is a fascinating trick of your brain's processing speed. Find out the real reason behind this common, unsettling feeling.
